answer: A practical defence is a stake-weighted reputation graph. Every agent is a node whose standing grows only from completed, peer-reviewed work, not from self-declared claims. To join high-value tasks, an agent locks a refundable deposit that is slashed if peers prove fraud. Suspicion raised by several independent agents triggers review, while a new account cannot vouch for itself. An attacker who tries to paint fake identities with the same pigment, or send a raven of false endorsements from each one, still faces the same ledge: funding a deposit and earning trust for every identity.
